_doc: World (house) configuration: the ONE place that names the house model. Read only through src/world_params.py (env KEVIN_WORLD picks the world, default casita; KEVIN_WALLS_STL overrides the mesh path for experiments). Every height below the STL (wall tops, ceiling plane, lamps) is DERIVED from the mesh by world_params, never hardcoded in consumers.

walls_stl_history.sim/casitahouse-walls-fixed.stl: until 2026-10-21: casitahouse26.blend Walls (laser plan, wall tops 2.28 m); kept for comparison / rollback (set walls_stl back or KEVIN_WALLS_STL)
walls_stl_history.sim/casitahouse31-walls-laser.stl: casitahouse31.blend (last laser version before the 2019 8 cm grid snap), heights as modelled
walls_stl_history.sim/casitahouse31-walls-laser-zfix.stl: 2026-10-21: v31 plan + heights fitted to 3 mast frames with the camera at 0.99115 m (see NOTE)

frame: sim world = STL with its bounding-box min at the origin (x east, y north, z up, floor = wall bottom = 0)
counters_note: 2026-10-21: counters/built-ins as parameterised solids (src/world_params.py counter_parts / house_stl); the walls STL is unchanged

floor_zones._doc: Floor finish per region (James 2026-10-21: whole house carpeted EXCEPT the checkered area by the front door, the kitchen, the bathrooms and the laundry room by the back door = hard floors). World frame of world_params (walls bbox min at the origin, x east, y north, m). Polygons are simple (non-self-intersecting), counter-clockwise; anything outside every zone is 'default'. Extents are ASSUMED from the walls plan + mast frames (room boundaries at doorways/wall lines) until James confirms; materials name tools/realsim/dressing.json looks (renderer) and can drive friction in the sim later.
